main_text.p: Etenim eo loco, Fanni & Scævola, locati sumus, ut nos longe prospicere debeat futuros casus reipub. Deflexit enim iam aliquantulum de spatio, curriculoq; consuetudo maiorum. Tyb. Grachus regnum occupare conatus est, ut rogavit is quidem paucos menses. Nūquid simile pop. Rom. audierat, aut viderat? Hunc etiam post mortem secuti amici, & propinqui. Quid in P. Scipionem Nasicam effecerint, sine lachrymis non queo dicere. Nam Carbonem quoq;, quę modo potuimus, propter recentem pœnam Tyb. Grachi fusti-nuimus. De C. Grachi autem tribunatu quid exspectem, non libet augurari. Serpit enim deinde res quæ proclivis ad perniciem cū semel cœpit, labitur. Videtis in tabella iam ante quanta sit facta labes, primo lege Gabinia, biennio autem post, Cassia. Videre iam videor populum Rom. à senatu disjunctū, multitudinisq; arbitrio maximas, res agi. Plures enim discent quemadmodum hæc fiant, quam quemadmodum his resistatur. Quorsum hæc? quia sine

page.notes: Page number "58" is printed in a form resembling a long s followed by 8; read as 58 [?]. Several words are set with ligatures or tildes that could be misread: "Nūquid" and "cū" have tildes as printed. The line-end hyphens in "Gra-chus", "fusti-nuimus", "bien-nio", "disjun-ctū" and "curricu-loq;" were joined where the word is continuous. The printed "Grachus" and "Tyb." are kept as printed. The catchword "sine" is at the lower right, and the scan cuts the word slightly, so it is marked as read.
